purpose: Evaluate whether bounded Atlas top-k candidates actually recover the pre-frozen owner target, rather than counting lexical non-empty results as success.

oracleBoundary.ownerTruth: pre-frozen exact committed owner source anchor remains authoritative
oracleBoundary.currentness: not adjudicated by the model; evaluated separately from source fences

matchClasses.TARGET: Candidate directly contains or faithfully states the frozen target standing.
matchClasses.CORRECT_SUCCESSOR: Candidate does not state the exact historical form but faithfully resolves to the current semantic successor relevant to the same target.
matchClasses.RELATED_ONLY: Candidate shares domain/theme/terms but does not recover the target standing.
matchClasses.NONE: No candidate is materially relevant to the target.

rules: The evaluator must not award TARGET merely because owner/project names or broad domain words match.
If several candidates are related but none contains the target distinction, targetRank=0 and semanticRecall=false.
Use the earliest genuinely target-bearing candidate as targetRank.
Do not infer owner currentness from an Atlas currentness label or from synthesis prose.
A curated synthesis can count as semantic recall even though owner-currentness still requires a separate owner-native re-entry.
A generated owner projection can count as semantic recall only if the candidate content itself contains the target standing; owner configuration alone is not recall.
